{{Quote|She's hooked up with a mercenary crew that includes a number of scary Trandoshans and along with Erran's two brothers: Hirsch and Doak, two very powerful soldiers.|A [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] report about [[Erran Sif]]|<ref name="10HSTG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref>}}
The '''Sif''' were a band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] assembled by [[Erran Sif]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|The traitor Erran Sif is leading a small group of warriors on Talus. She betrayed the Empire in the past and is considered an enemy, so don't expect a friendly reception. I hear she's also no friend to the Rebel Alliance for whatever that's worth.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Velso]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Lt. Velso"}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] Erran Sif was wanted by both the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for selling information to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. She had thus fled from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to Talus, where she assembled a group of mercenaries.<ref name="10HSTG" />

[[File:Sif_bunker.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Sif bunker]]]]
The Sif mercenaries were based in a [[Sif bunker|bunker]] in the [[Akazi Plains]].<ref name="SWG:ES" /> They included a number of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and Erran's two brothers, [[Hirsch Sif|Hirsch]] and [[Doak Sif]].<ref name="10HSTG" /> The Sif were in open conflict with both the Empire and the Rebels, but they were allied with the Hutts.<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref>
